publisher.title: Publisher
wiz.heading: Family Relay Publisher
wiz.intro: Stand up a server that produces routes for your trusted recipients. Seven steps, around 10 minutes for a fresh operator.
wiz.step.label: Step {n} of {total}
wiz.step.operator.title: Name your server
wiz.step.operator.blurb: You're about to set up a private relay server that your family and friends can use to reach the open internet. Daal handles all the technical parts — you just need an account with a cloud provider. Your access key stays encrypted on this device.
wiz.step.provider.title: Cloud account
wiz.step.provider.blurb: Your relay runs on a rented cloud server. Pick a provider below, sign up if you haven't, then paste the access key they give you. We encrypt it on your phone with a PIN you choose.
wiz.step.pricing.title: Server & cost
wiz.step.pricing.blurb: We've picked the best settings for your server. Review the location and estimated cost below.
wiz.step.keys.title: Publisher keys
wiz.step.keys.blurb: Generate a new Ed25519 signing key for this operator. Recipients trust your routes by recognising this key, so back up the fingerprint shown here.
wiz.step.provision.title: Provision
wiz.step.provision.blurb: Daal calls the cloud provider, spins up the server, hardens it and runs the toolbox bring-up. You can watch the live progress log.
wiz.step.sign.title: Create relay pack
wiz.step.sign.blurb: A relay pack is the file your recipient's Daal app needs to use this server. It contains the routes you've enabled here, signed with your publisher key so only your recipients can trust it.
wiz.step.distribute.title: Send to recipient
wiz.step.distribute.blurb: Send the relay pack to one or more recipients. They open it in Daal on their phone to start using this server. You can re-send it later from the server list on step 1.
wiz.op.empty: You haven't set up a server yet. Pick a name below to get started.

wiz.provider.signup: Don't have an account? Sign up →
wiz.provider.vps.tip.title: You only need an account — not a server
wiz.provider.vps.tip.body: Don't create a server on their website. Just sign up, then in the console go to your project (Default) → Security → API Tokens → Generate API Token (select Read & Write). Copy and paste that token here. Daal creates and configures the server for you automatically — the right size, operating system, firewall, everything. Costs around €4–5/month.

relaypack.p1: A RelayPack is a small set of internet routes your diaspora family member set up for you on a server outside Iran. Your Daal app picks the route that works best on your network right now. If one route stops working, Daal switches to another automatically.
relaypack.p2: They rented a small server (about €5/month) and ran a one-time wizard that sets the server up safely. The server is yours; nothing leaves their machine; nobody else uses your routes.
relaypack.h3: What does your Daal app do?
relaypack.p3: When your network changes — new Wi-Fi, mobile data, café — Daal runs five small probes to see what works on this network. It picks the best route from your RelayPack and explains its choice in one sentence. If a route fails, it cools down and tries another. No information leaves your phone.
